name: figma-workspace
description: Independent npm command entrypoints and a shared typed Node.js runtime for file-based Figma workspace automation.

interface.shortDescription: Automate Figma through independent npm commands and a shared typed runtime.
interface.longDescription: Provides independent plugin-root npm command entrypoints backed by one shared typed Node.js runtime for repairable .figma.ts workflows, project docs, persisted session context and history, live upstream discovery, diagnostics, assets, captures, guidance, and lookup. Direct commands expose task-shaped arguments, while JSON commands expose input, state, and output controls.
